title: Prove full-loop packet backing bound and action storage interface
body:
PR2874 establishes retained packet backing at prefix-return cuts and leaves the rest of the loop open. This package proves the exact named-array maximum across the unchanged PR2697 packet loop, including completed output copies and factory temporaries, and supplies a phase-correct interface for action-private backing.

For N prefixes of F payload symbols, borrowed backing K, directory D and fresh prefix backing Q, the maximum is `M = K + (2N+1)F + 4 + D + 2Q + max(Q,F)`. For example N=2,F=9,Q=4,K=19,D=7 gives prefix peak 87 but copy peak 92. This extends the predecessor's explicitly restricted claim. With action-private backing at most A, including its pending result and excluding caller arrays, the combined bound is `max(M, K + 2NF + 3 + D + 2Q + A)`. A literal counterexample shows why borrowed backing must stay fixed throughout an action, rather than only be restored at return.

Evidence:

- Registered CPython 3.12.13 replay passed: 99 source-execution fixtures, 693 prefix-return and 693 copy-completion cuts, and 10 meaningful accounting/domain/integrity controls.
- Separate integer-identity model: 5,040 parameter cases, 10,080 schedules, 2,278,920 modeled cuts; distinguishes aligned from early-only private-storage peaks.
- Relocated Git-free, read-only-file CPython 3.14.4 optimized replay passed all three commands with unchanged bytes. All 23 exported source entries match their original Git blobs; final committed-byte and metadata checks passed after rebase.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-packet-backing-envelope`. Start review with the package's README.md and PROOF.md; most added files are byte-identical portable source exports and the generated receipt.

Scope: this is a named backing-array component, not total caller memory, physical reuse, native private-scratch certification, a full selected GL64 replay, supplier admission or new kappa. The native sign fixtures certify caller storage and output only; synthetic actions instantiate the private-storage interface. Remaining tasks are an actual native A bound and the same-cut join of other owners plus physical erasure/placement/reuse.

Separate snapshots are not atomic; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are excluded. Fresh predecessor heads are unchanged. The selected frontier remains untouched.
